coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Three of eight ground-truth variable items substantially match (38%, rounded): consistent use of R², the required training-size levels (with an additional 10% level), and the 26 car-design parameters. Model architecture and predictive-performance measurement match only partially.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output replaces the 80/20 split with 70/15/15 and omits the fixed CSV path. It omits AutoGluon and a distinct GradientBoosting model while adding Ridge, MLP, and GPR. Body-type subgroup analysis does not establish the required fastback-only versus combined dataset comparison. Performance is summarized over five seeds using means and standard deviations rather than average R² with confidence intervals over 20 splits. Additional accuracy and computational-cost metrics are not ground-truth variables.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: It fails to state the expected improvement with increasing training size or the model-specific findings: AutoGluon performs well in the single-design scenario, whereas LightGBM excels on the combined dataset.
